doc.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Bebop, band changes and the road
title: Why Katz, Collette, Hall and Horn left or joined
summary: Fred Katz went home to film work, Buddy stayed for money, Jim Hall may have gotten bored and wanted to stay east, and Paul Horn was recommended.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Okay. Well then that brings us up to where we left off yesterday, where you had just disbanded your world famous quintet.
Right, and I told you why.
Yes, you did say why. But what I want to talk about was, you know, the quintet itself went through different personnel changes.
You started with Fred Katz and then -­
Right. Why did Fred leave, do you remember?

On his own volition. You know, Fred got famous and started writing, you know, doing a lot film stuff and decided to stay home in LA, you know. The road can get to you, you dig? So it kind of got to him, you know, and here again man, Fred was -- you know, we were both about the same age. He was no young dude, you know. But I’d been on the road all my life, you know, that’s all I know is the road.

And then you started with Buddy. You founded the group with Buddy Collette and then, you know, you had several personnel changes. You went through Paul Horn, Eric Dolphy, and then, you know, you had Charles Lloyd. So the same reason for Buddy, why he left the group?
Buddy stayed on because he was making money and, you know, he had a family to support.
And what about Jim Hall, because that was your founding group.
Yeah. Jim lasted, you know, to the point -- Jim might have just got bored. I don’t know.
Of course then he goes on to play with Sonny but that’s later.
That was way down the line. He started with -- well he got to do some deals with Jimmy Guiffre and he dug that so -- plus the fact he wanted to stay east, you know.
And how did Paul Horn get into the group?
Somebody recommended him, you know, and I heard him and, you know, gave him a shot.
